themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and South America are assessing the fallout of US midterm election setbacks for Donald Trump. From internal AfD debates in Germany to strategic anxieties in Argentina and UK Reform maneuvering, right-wing leaders are recalibrating their public stance toward Trumpism.
